note: District catalogue for the OBP Notice & Mailing Kit. 'confirmed' entries carry a court-published BNC-disruption page read on last_verified; 'unreviewed' entries carry only the court's official website and no claim about its guidance. Never invent guidance for an unreviewed district. See ../README.md to retire the outage advisory.

national.summary: Oct. 15 statement: a cybersecurity incident at BAE Systems, the contractor that operates the Bankruptcy Noticing Center, has made the BNC systems and websites unavailable and halted the BNC's production and distribution of bankruptcy notices; BAE is working to restore operations; no restoration date was stated.
